title: Search Arena: Analyzing Search-Augmented LLMs
paper_type_zh: 搜索增强语言模型的人类偏好数据集与分析论文
best_for_zh: 研究检索增强生成、搜索对话偏好或引用可靠性的读者。
one_line: Search Arena releases real multi-turn search-LLM battles with user votes and full retrieval traces, exposing the difference between preferred and well-supported answers.
Search Arena 发布真实搜索增强模型对话、用户偏好票和检索轨迹，可检验偏好与引用支撑是否一致。
why: It joins observed human preferences to the retrieved evidence needed to audit whether citation-rich answers are actually grounded.
inclusion_reason: Search Arena releases real paired search-LLM conversations, user preference judgments, and retrieval traces for preference learning and grounding analysis.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Static, single-turn fact questions cannot show how people actually compare search-augmented assistants, navigate multi-turn retrieval, or react to citations that look credible but fail to support a claim.

Search Arena records real side-by-side search conversations and optional votes, preserving the model replies and search traces needed to study both preference and grounding.

静态、单轮的事实问题无法揭示人们如何比较搜索增强助手、如何在多轮检索中互动，或如何对看似可信却未支撑主张的引用作出反应。

Search Arena 记录真实的并排搜索对话和可选投票，保留模型回复与搜索轨迹，以便同时研究偏好和事实支撑。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Search Arena pairs natural user conversations with two anonymized search-LLM responses, a human choice when cast, and the retrieval context behind both answers. Its 24,069-row official Parquet release contains 12,652 votes from roughly 11,000 users in 136 countries, with about 90 languages; records expose paired messages, timestamps, full system and search metadata, language, and intent. Unlike preference data without evidence context, it can separate what users like from what citations substantiate. User prompts are CC-BY-4.0, but model outputs retain their providers' terms.

Search Arena 将自然用户对话与两份匿名搜索模型回答、用户作出的选择及其背后的检索上下文配对。官方 Parquet 发布版有 24,069 条记录、12,652 张投票，来自约 11,000 名、覆盖 136 国和约 90 种语言的用户；记录包含配对消息、时间戳、完整系统和搜索元数据、语言及意图。不同于不带证据上下文的偏好数据，它能区分用户喜欢什么和引用实际支撑什么。用户提示采用 CC-BY-4.0，模型输出仍受各提供方条款约束。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect paired interactions. A visitor accepts the service terms, chats with two anonymous search-enabled models in parallel, and may vote A better, B better, tie, or both bad. The output is a multi-turn battle with model and search traces.
  1. Filter and de-identify. The release removes server errors, inconsistent configurations, and other quality failures; Google DLP redacts identifiers and sensitive content. Records retain timestamps, language and intent annotations, and system metadata after this processing.
  1. Analyze preferences against evidence. The authors fit controlled preference analyses and use an LLM pipeline to label whether citations support, are irrelevant to, or contradict claims. This distinguishes citation abundance from factual attribution.
  1. Reuse with a fixed revision and terms audit. The official repository provides JSONL data and analysis scripts. Any training split, privacy assessment, and evaluation time boundary must be defined by the reuser because the release is observational deployment data rather than a prescribed training benchmark.

1. 收集配对互动。 访客接受服务条款后，与两个匿名搜索模型并排对话，并可选择 A 更好、B 更好、平局或都不好。输出是带模型和搜索轨迹的多轮对战记录。
  1. 过滤和去标识化。 发布版去除服务器错误、配置不一致及其他质量失败样本；Google DLP 删除标识符和敏感内容。处理后仍保留时间戳、语言和意图标注及系统元数据。
  1. 将偏好与证据对照分析。 作者进行受控偏好分析，并用语言模型流程标记引用是支撑、无关还是反驳某项主张，从而把引用数量与事实归因区分开来。
  1. 以固定版本和条款审查复用。 官方仓库提供 JSONL 数据和分析脚本。由于该发布版是部署观察数据而非规定的训练基准，训练划分、隐私评估和评测时间边界须由复用者自行定义。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The citation analysis controls for response style and finds that users prefer more citations even when cited content does not directly support the associated claims. This observation uses the released paired conversations, retrieved content, and attribution labels rather than a static answer benchmark. It supports a gap between perceived credibility and grounding in this deployment; it does not establish that every citation-rich answer is unsupported or that the observed users represent all search users.
引用分析控制了回答风格后发现，即使被引内容并未直接支撑相关主张，用户仍偏好引用更多的回答。该观察使用已发布的配对对话、检索内容和归因标注，而非静态答案基准。它支持该部署环境中“感知可信度”与事实支撑之间存在缺口，但不证明每个引用丰富的回答都缺乏支撑，也不证明这些用户代表所有搜索用户。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier search datasets are commonly static, English-only, single-turn fact questions. Search Arena changes the object of study to consented, multi-turn production interactions with paired answers, votes, and retrieval traces. The novelty is joining preference and evidence in the same record; side-by-side voting and web search themselves are not new. Before reuse, inspect the model-output terms and residual privacy risk.
早期搜索数据集通常是静态、英文、单轮的事实问题。Search Arena 将研究对象改为经同意的生产环境多轮互动，并在同一记录中结合配对回答、投票和检索轨迹。其新意在于将偏好与证据联结，而非并排投票或网页搜索本身；复用前应检查模型输出条款和残余隐私风险。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Votes come from self-selected Arena visitors and are absent for about half the conversations, so they should not be read as a population preference distribution. Stratify by intent, language, and vote availability before treating them as training targets.

Automated DLP redaction and terms consent reduce privacy risk but cannot prove that every conversational detail is safe to redistribute. Recheck sensitive fields and current provider terms before training on model outputs.

投票来自自选的 Arena 访客，且约半数对话没有投票，因此不能把它们当作总体偏好分布。将其用作训练目标前，应按意图、语言和是否有投票分层检查。

自动 DLP 脱敏和条款同意降低了隐私风险，却不能证明每个对话细节都可安全再发布。训练模型输出前应复查敏感字段及当前提供方条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use Search Arena to audit a search assistant: compare paired outputs with retrieved sources, then measure whether a reward model favors supported claims rather than citation count. Work from a pinned dataset revision and permitted output subset; report privacy screening, output terms, and results by language and intent.

Do not use it to infer a user's private beliefs or as a license-free corpus of every model response.

可用 Search Arena 审计搜索助手：将配对输出与检索来源对照，衡量奖励模型是否偏好有支撑的主张而非更多引用。应固定数据版本和允许使用的输出子集，并报告隐私筛查、输出条款及按语言和意图分组的结果。

不应用它推断用户的私人信念，也不能把所有模型输出视为无许可限制的语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The release connects real search conversations, paired outputs, votes, and retrieval traces.
  • It contains 24,069 conversations and 12,652 votes, not 24K voted pairs.
  • More citations can win a vote without directly supporting a claim.
  • Prompt text is CC-BY-4.0; model output permissions differ by provider.
  • Check privacy, output terms, and vote selection before training.

• 该发布版把真实搜索对话、配对输出、投票和检索轨迹联结在一起。
  • 它含 24,069 段对话和 12,652 张投票，而非 2.4 万个已投票对。
  • 更多引用可能赢得投票，却未必直接支撑主张。
  • 提示文本采用 CC-BY-4.0，模型输出权限因提供方而异。
  • 训练前须检查隐私、输出条款和投票选择偏差。
